page.title: 数えられないものは、単位で数える

analysis.summaryJa: water・paper・advice・equipmentのような不可算名詞は、そのまま数詞を付けて個数を表せない。数えるときは、容器・形・一まとまり・測定単位を表す可算名詞を前に置き、bottle of water、sheet of paper、piece of adviceのように単位を切り出す。二つ以上なら複数になるのはbottles・sheets・piecesなどの単位名であり、後ろの不可算名詞は通常そのままである。動詞との一致も中心となる単位名の単複に従う。何を一単位として見せるかを選ぶことで、数えられない量を具体的な個数や測定値として伝えられる。
grammarPoints: 不可算名詞を数えるときは可算の単位名＋of＋不可算名詞を使う
容器を表すbottle・cup・boxなどで中身を一単位として切り出せる
形を表すsheet・slice・bar・loafなどで材料の一部やまとまりを数えられる
抽象物や集合物にはpiece of advice・piece of information・item of equipmentなどを使う
二つ以上では単位名を複数形にし、後ろの不可算名詞には通常複数-sを付けない
数詞は単位名にかかり、動詞の数も単位名の単複に合わせる
liter・kilogramなどの測定単位でも不可算の物質量を数値化できる
visualEvidence: 水のまとまりがbottleという境界へ入り、one bottle of waterになる図
紙の連続した材料からsheetを切り出して複数枚を数える図
breadをloafやsliceという異なる単位で区切る対比
adviceとinformationへpieceという数えられるタグを付ける構図
two cups of coffeeで複数になるのがcupsだけであることを示す強調
commonTraps: two waters・three advicesのように不可算名詞を直接複数化する
数詞の後でもunit名を単数のままにする
two pieces of informationsのように単位名と不可算名詞の両方を複数化する
a advice・an equipmentのように不可算名詞へa/anを直接付ける
単位名と中身のofを落とす
複数の単位名を主語にしながら単数動詞を使う

questions.prompt: The catering staff placed six ------- of water on each conference table.

choices.B: waters
choices.C: bottles

questions.translationJa: ケータリング担当者は各会議用テーブルに水を6本置きました。
questions.explanationJa: sixの後ろでは容器を表すbottleを複数形bottlesにし、of waterと続けます。

questions.prompt: Please print the signed agreement on two ------- of paper.

choices.B: sheet
choices.C: papers

questions.translationJa: 署名済みの契約書を紙2枚に印刷してください。
questions.explanationJa: 紙を枚数で数えるときはtwo sheets of paperとし、paperは不可算のままです。

questions.prompt: The café delivered three ------- of coffee to the reception desk.

choices.B: coffees
choices.C: cups coffee

questions.translationJa: カフェは受付へコーヒーを3杯届けました。
questions.explanationJa: 飲み物の一杯を数える可算単位cupをthreeに合わせてcupsにします。

questions.prompt: The trainer gave us two useful ------- of advice before the role-play exercise.

choices.B: pieces
choices.C: advices

questions.translationJa: 研修担当者はロールプレイの前に役立つ助言を2つくれました。
questions.explanationJa: adviceは不可算なので、個別の助言はtwo pieces of adviceと表します。

questions.prompt: The bakery will supply four ------- of bread for the staff breakfast.

choices.B: loaf
choices.C: breads

questions.translationJa: パン店は従業員の朝食用にパンを4斤供給します。
questions.explanationJa: パンを丸ごとのまとまりで数える単位loafの複数形はloavesです。

questions.prompt: Each participant received ------- of cake after the product presentation.

choices.B: some slice
choices.C: a slice

questions.translationJa: 各参加者は商品発表後にケーキを1切れ受け取りました。
questions.explanationJa: 一切れは可算単位sliceを使い、単数なのでa slice of cakeとします。

questions.prompt: The emergency generator requires at least 200 ------- of fuel for a full-day test.

choices.B: liters
choices.C: fuels

questions.translationJa: 非常用発電機の終日試験には少なくとも200リットルの燃料が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 燃料の量を測る単位literを200に合わせて複数形litersにします。

questions.prompt: The welcome package contained two ------- of locally made chocolate.

choices.B: chocolates
choices.C: bars chocolate

questions.translationJa: 歓迎用パッケージには地元製チョコレートが2枚入っていました。
questions.explanationJa: 板状のチョコレートを数える単位barをtwoに合わせてbarsにします。

questions.prompt: The media room needs one additional ------- of equipment for live streaming.

choices.B: items
choices.C: equipment

questions.translationJa: メディア室にはライブ配信用の機器がもう1点必要です。
questions.explanationJa: one additionalの後ろは単数単位itemで、item of equipmentとします。

questions.prompt: The verification form asks for three separate ------- of information.

choices.B: pieces
choices.C: informations

questions.translationJa: 確認用紙では別々の情報を3項目求めています。
questions.explanationJa: informationは不可算なので、three pieces of informationで個別項目を数えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence counting containers of juice.

choices.A: The hotel ordered twelve bottle of juice for the meeting.
choices.B: The hotel ordered twelve juices bottle for the meeting.
choices.C: The hotel ordered twelve bottles of juices for the meeting.
choices.D: The hotel ordered twelve bottles of juice for the meeting.

questions.translationJa: ホテルは会議用にジュースを12本注文しました。
questions.explanationJa: twelveに合わせて容器bottleだけを複数形にし、juiceは不可算のままです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing one recommendation.

choices.A: Ms. Ito offered a useful advice.
choices.B: Ms. Ito offered a useful piece of advice.
choices.C: Ms. Ito offered one useful advices.
choices.D: Ms. Ito offered a useful piece advice.

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんは役立つ助言を1つしました。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算adviceの一項目はa piece of adviceと表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence counting flat units of paper.

choices.A: Five sheets of paper are beside the printer.
choices.B: Five sheet of paper is beside the printer.
choices.C: Five sheets of papers are beside the printer.
choices.D: Five paper sheets is beside the printer.

questions.translationJa: プリンターの横に紙が5枚あります。
questions.explanationJa: fiveに合わせてsheetsを複数形にし、paperは不可算のままです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence counting servings of coffee.

choices.A: The assistant brought three cup of coffee for the visitors.
choices.B: The assistant brought three cups coffee for the visitors.
choices.C: The assistant brought three cups of coffee for the visitors.
choices.D: The assistant brought three cups of coffees for the visitors.

questions.translationJa: 補助担当者は来訪者へコーヒーを3杯持ってきました。
questions.explanationJa: three cups of coffeeが、杯数を数える正しい単位表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence counting whole units of bread.

choices.A: One loaves of bread are enough for the breakfast buffet.
choices.B: One loaf of bread is enough for the breakfast buffet.
choices.C: A bread loaf are enough for the breakfast buffet.
choices.D: One loaf of breads is enough for the breakfast buffet.

questions.translationJa: 朝食ビュッフェにはパン1斤で十分です。
questions.explanationJa: oneに続く単位loafは単数で、主語全体をisで受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence counting devices within equipment.

choices.A: Two equipment were moved to the new office.
choices.B: Two items of equipments were moved to the new office.
choices.C: Two item of equipment was moved to the new office.
choices.D: Two items of equipment were moved to the new office.

questions.translationJa: 機器2点が新しい事務所へ移されました。
questions.explanationJa: equipmentを個別に数えるにはtwo items of equipmentを使い、動詞はwereです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence counting shaped units of chocolate.

choices.A: A chocolate was included as bar in each gift bag.
choices.B: A bar chocolate were included in each gift bag.
choices.C: A bar of chocolate was included in each gift bag.
choices.D: A bar of chocolates was included in each gift bag.

questions.translationJa: 各ギフト袋には板チョコが1枚入っていました。
questions.explanationJa: 一枚の板状単位はa bar of chocolateで、chocolateは不可算のままです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing a measured fuel quantity.

choices.A: The supplier delivered twenty liters of fuel before noon.
choices.B: The supplier delivered twenty liter of fuel before noon.
choices.C: The supplier delivered twenty liters fuel before noon.
choices.D: The supplier delivered twenty liters of fuels before noon.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は正午前に燃料を20リットル届けました。
questions.explanationJa: 測定単位literをtwentyに合わせてlitersにし、of fuelと続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence counting cut portions of cheese.

choices.A: Four slice of cheese was placed on each tray.
choices.B: Four slices cheese were placed on each tray.
choices.C: Four slices of cheese were placed on each tray.
choices.D: Four slices of cheeses was placed on each tray.

questions.translationJa: 各トレーにはチーズが4切れ置かれました。
questions.explanationJa: fourに合わせてslicesを複数形にし、cheeseは不可算のままです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence counting separate facts.

choices.B: The application requires two pieces of information.
choices.C: The application requires two pieces of informations.
choices.D: The application requires two piece information.

questions.translationJa: 応募書類には情報が2項目必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算informationを数える正しい形はtwo pieces of informationです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We ordered three bottles of water."

choices.A: We ordered three uncountable waters without containers.
choices.B: We ordered water divided into three bottle-sized containers.
choices.C: We ordered one bottle that contained three waters.
choices.D: We ordered three bottles with no water in them.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは水をボトル3本分注文しました。
questions.explanationJa: three bottlesが容器の個数を示し、waterはその中身です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The consultant gave me a piece of advice."

choices.A: The consultant gave me several advices.
choices.B: The consultant sold me a piece of equipment.
choices.C: The consultant refused to offer any guidance.
choices.D: The consultant gave me one specific recommendation.

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントは私に具体的な助言を1つくれました。
questions.explanationJa: a piece of adviceは不可算の助言から一項目を切り出します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Please use two sheets of paper."

choices.A: Please use two kinds of paperwork.
choices.B: Please use one sheet printed twice.
choices.C: Please use two separate flat pieces of paper.
choices.D: Please use an uncountable amount of papers.

questions.translationJa: 別々の紙を2枚使ってください。
questions.explanationJa: sheetは紙を平らな一枚として数える単位です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The server brought four cups of coffee."

choices.A: The server brought four cup-sized servings of coffee.
choices.B: The server brought four coffee beans.
choices.C: The server brought one cup four times but no coffee.
choices.D: The server brought four types of empty cups only.

questions.translationJa: 給仕担当者はコーヒーを4杯分持ってきました。
questions.explanationJa: cupsは提供単位の数、coffeeは中身を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The bakery delivered a loaf of bread."

choices.A: The bakery delivered one thin slice only.
choices.B: The bakery delivered several breads as a mass.
choices.C: The bakery delivered flour rather than bread.
choices.D: The bakery delivered one whole baked unit of bread.

questions.translationJa: パン店はパンを丸ごと1斤届けました。
questions.explanationJa: loafは切る前のパン一まとまりを表す可算単位です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The lab purchased two items of equipment."

choices.A: The lab purchased two equipments directly.
choices.B: The lab purchased an unspecified amount of furniture.
choices.C: The lab purchased two separately countable devices.
choices.D: The lab borrowed one device twice.

questions.translationJa: 研究室は個別に数えられる機器を2点購入しました。
questions.explanationJa: itemsによって不可算equipmentの中の個別装置を二つ数えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Each guest received a slice of cake."

choices.A: Each guest received a whole cake factory.
choices.B: Each guest received one cut portion of cake.
choices.C: Each guest received several cakes without portions.

questions.translationJa: 各宿泊客はケーキを1切れ受け取りました。
questions.explanationJa: sliceは切り分けた一部分を一単位として示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The tank holds fifty liters of fuel."

choices.A: The tank contains fifty separate fuels.
choices.B: The tank contains fifty fuel tanks.
choices.C: The tank contains a fuel volume measured as fifty liters.
choices.D: The tank is empty because liters cannot be measured.

questions.translationJa: タンクには50リットルと測定される量の燃料が入ります。
questions.explanationJa: litersは不可算の燃料を体積で数値化する測定単位です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The gift box contains two bars of chocolate."

choices.A: The gift box contains two liquid chocolates.
choices.B: The gift box contains one bar with no chocolate.
choices.C: The gift box contains an unlimited amount of chocolate.
choices.D: The gift box contains two separately shaped chocolate bars.

questions.translationJa: ギフト箱には板状のチョコレートが2枚入っています。
questions.explanationJa: barsが板状のまとまりを二つ数えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We need three pieces of information."

choices.A: We need three separate facts or information items.
choices.B: We need three informations with plural endings.
choices.C: We need one fact repeated three times.
choices.D: We do not need any information.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは別々の情報項目を3つ必要としています。
questions.explanationJa: piecesによって不可算informationを個別項目として数えています。

questions.prompt: The meeting room has twenty attendees but no drinks. Please bring twenty ------- of water before 9 a.m.

choices.B: bottle
choices.C: waters

questions.translationJa: 会議室には参加者が20人いますが飲み物がありません。午前9時前に水を20本持ってきてください。
questions.explanationJa: twentyに合わせて容器単位bottleを複数形bottlesにします。

questions.prompt: The printer stopped because the tray was empty. Add at least ten ------- of paper and restart it.

choices.B: papers
choices.C: sheets

questions.translationJa: 給紙トレイが空でプリンターが止まりました。紙を少なくとも10枚入れて再起動してください。
questions.explanationJa: 紙の枚数はten sheets of paperと表します。

questions.prompt: Three clients are waiting in the lounge. The café will send three ------- of coffee shortly.

choices.B: coffees
choices.C: cups coffee

questions.translationJa: ラウンジで顧客3人が待っています。カフェがまもなくコーヒーを3杯届けます。
questions.explanationJa: 提供する杯数を表すためthree cups of coffeeを使います。

questions.prompt: The draft is generally strong, but the editor offered two ------- of advice about the conclusion.

choices.B: pieces
choices.C: advices

questions.translationJa: 草案は全体として良いですが、編集者は結論について助言を2つしました。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算adviceの個別項目はtwo pieces of adviceです。

questions.prompt: The breakfast buffet serves forty guests. The kitchen has ordered eight ------- of bread.

choices.B: breads
choices.C: loafs

questions.translationJa: 朝食ビュッフェでは40人に提供します。厨房はパンを8斤注文しました。
questions.explanationJa: eightの後ろではloafの不規則複数loavesを使います。

questions.prompt: The cheese platter looks empty. Please add six more ------- of cheese before the guests arrive.

choices.B: slice
choices.C: cheeses

questions.translationJa: チーズ盛り合わせが空いて見えます。来客前にチーズをさらに6切れ加えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 切り分けたチーズはsix slices of cheeseと数えます。

questions.prompt: The delivery truck is nearly empty. It needs thirty ------- of fuel to complete today's route.

choices.B: fuels
choices.C: liters

questions.translationJa: 配送車の燃料がほぼ空です。本日の経路を終えるには30リットル必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 燃料量を測る単位literをthirtyに合わせて複数形にします。

questions.prompt: The supplier sent promotional gifts for ten visitors. Each bag contains two ------- of chocolate.

choices.B: chocolates
choices.C: bars chocolate

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は来訪者10人分の販促品を送りました。各袋には板チョコが2枚入っています。
questions.explanationJa: 板状の単位はtwo bars of chocolateと表します。

questions.prompt: The video studio has cameras but lacks lighting devices. We need two additional ------- of equipment.

choices.B: item
choices.C: equipments

questions.translationJa: 映像スタジオにはカメラがありますが照明機器が不足しています。機器をあと2点必要としています。
questions.explanationJa: equipmentを個別装置として数えるためtwo items of equipmentを使います。

questions.prompt: To confirm your identity, the agent will ask for two ------- of information: your booking code and birth date.

choices.B: pieces
choices.C: informations

questions.translationJa: 本人確認のため、担当者は予約コードと生年月日という2項目の情報を尋ねます。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの情報項目はtwo pieces of informationと表します。
